_comment: Run template for ornl-frp-vav: the rooftop unit (AHU RTU__<scenario>) and its ten VAV boxes (VAV RTU_VAV_<room>__<scenario>) of each one-day scenario. Zone rules run on every box; only the box under test is scored (unmet_setpoint_hours -> terminal_damper). The SAT rogue-zone and cohort-starvation censuses group each scenario's boxes under that scenario's RTU through the naming topology (scenario-aware). economizer_high_limit uses the building's own sequence (economizer enabled below 10 C = 50 F outdoor air; 10% minimum damper, Table 3). Declined: outdoor_air_fraction (the mixed-air sensor reads below return air in cooling -- data issue mixed-air-below-return-in-cooling -- so it faults on every summer fault-free day); supply_air_reset_compliance (the design is a fixed 12.8 C supply air, not a G36 reset); airflow_tracking, overcooling_min_flow, reheat_minimization_g36 and the static-pressure censuses (no airflow setpoint is logged); reheat_penalty and zones_heat_cool_census (the electric reheat is logged as energy, not a valve); damper_census, cohort_airflow and cohort_space_temp (they pool every box building-wide, which here mixes 31 different test days).
